# Groq Free as a distinct replacement route (26 September 2026)

**Disposition: conditional, not qualified.** This is an external service option for M11-OPS-02c, not evidence about Google's Co-Scientist. No Groq inference, runtime adapter, default switch, or production deployment has occurred.

The owner's existing Groq organization visibly has the **Free ($0)** plan. Its **Inference APIs ZDR** control was disabled and was enabled on 26 September; a subsequent readback showed it enabled. Global ZDR and the Batch/Fine-tuning controls were left unchanged. Two newly created, unused 30-day keys were revoked after their handoff failed. The owner then created a replacement campaign key and copied it for secure transfer. It is stored outside the repository in a local mode-0600 file; existing unrelated keys were untouched. A credentialed read-only `GET /openai/v1/models` returned HTTP 200 and listed `openai/gpt-oss-120b`. This verifies access, not inference behavior, account billing, or scientific suitability. Do not put a key or account identifier in this repository.

Official documentation for `openai/gpt-oss-120b` lists a 131,072-token context, 65,536-token maximum completion, structured output, tool calling, streaming, and a Free-plan allowance of 30 requests/minute, 1,000 requests/day, 8,000 tokens/minute, and 200,000 tokens/day. [Models](https://console.groq.com/docs/models), [rate limits](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits), [structured outputs](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs). Structured output cannot share one request with tool calling or streaming; the present app uses those shapes in separate calls. Groq says inference data is normally not retained and that enabling Inference APIs ZDR opts out of its otherwise possible reliability/abuse logging. [Data controls](https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data). The current Free plan is a billing property of this account, not a per-request zero-price cap. A later account upgrade would invalidate the campaign's zero-spend admission, so any use needs a fresh plan/ZDR readback and must stop on 429 rather than falling through to a paid path.

The provisional test-first adapter now admits only `groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b` as a system/default free route and pins `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1`. Every system-configured `groq/*` model enters the free gate, so aliases and other Groq models fail before transport; explicit user BYOK remains separate outside campaign mode. The app recognizes `GROQ_API_KEY`, and live evaluation keeps that key while removing other provider credentials. The guard rejects SDK fallbacks, extra bodies/plugins, server tools, non-text input and unsupported request fields. It admits the app's boolean streaming shape. No model default or production setting has changed.

Each non-BYOK Groq request requires `COSCIENTIST_GROQ_FREE_ZDR_ATTESTATION=<current UTC YYYY-MM-DD>:<SHA-256 of effective Groq API key>`. The marker asserts that an operator checked the account's Free plan and Inference APIs ZDR for that key on the same UTC date. Missing, stale or mismatched markers fail closed. It is **not** provider-authenticated billing evidence and cannot detect a same-day plan upgrade; remove it immediately if the plan, ZDR setting or key changes. The current account must be read back again immediately before each live batch. The Free quotas are not proven sufficient for the smallest complete research run; the Express 1,200-call setting is a runaway backstop, not an observed call count. A bounded actual-interface screen and public scientific-quality prerequisites must pass before any default or deployment change. No full-run suitability follows from the provider's model list.
